Field: Industrial and information engineering / 09/IINF-05 Sistemi di elaborazione delle informazioni

The project aims to develop and evaluate Multi-Armed Bandit (MAB) techniques for personalized behavioral recommendations in oncology. The main objective is to design adaptive algorithms that progressively learn from user interactions and identify effective, personalized recommendation strategies. Activities will include a review of the state of the art, algorithm design and implementation, and evaluation using available data or simulated environments. The project will assess the feasibility, performance, and potential applicability of the proposed approaches in oncological settings.

Investigation of the thermocatalytic conversion of lignocellulosic and/or residual biomass in zinc chloride-based molten salts for the production of energy vectors. It combines two research areas: workplace diversity and inclusion strategies, focusing on equal opportunities, participation and organisational well-being; and the adoption of smart electric mobility solutions, considering socioeconomic benefits, industrial effects and sustainability. Advanced data analysis will separate acoustic and hydrodynamic velocities near the wall. The numerical database will enable comparison of inverse methods, reveal the physical causes of anomalous results and support physicsbased corrections. It will also help model and predict the drag increase caused by acoustic–flow coupling. These findings will resolve…
